notes: Dates as listed on the homepage; the season is stated as ending 2 November yet 29 November 2026 is also listed, so it is probably a special end-of-year edition — kept as listed. Hours read from /anmeldung-info/. Organiser is a private individual named in the imprint. Entry fee not stated. No 2027 dates published.

description.de: Alle zwei Wochen sonntags von 10 bis 17 Uhr am Maybachufer am Landwehrkanal, von März bis November. Bis zu 130 Stände mit privatem Second-Hand, Kunst, Musik und Handgemachtem; industrielle Neuware ist ausgeschlossen. Die Standplätze werden zwölf Tage vorher online vergeben und sind in Sekunden weg.
description.en: Every other Sunday from 10 to 5 on Maybachufer beside the Landwehrkanal, March to November. Up to 130 stalls of private second-hand, art, music and handmade things; industrially made new goods are excluded. Stall bookings open online twelve days ahead and sell out within seconds.
